questions.topic: Page 7: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 7-8 Focus)
questions.questionText: Based on the reflection of $\Delta ADM$ across the y-axis, which of the following properties is preserved in the transformed triangle $\Delta A'D'M'$?

options.optionText: The coordinates of the vertices remain unchanged.
The lengths of the sides of the triangle are preserved.
The orientation of the triangle remains clockwise.
The x-coordinates of the vertices remain unchanged.

questions.explanationAnswer: Reflection across an axis is an isometry, meaning it preserves distances between points. Therefore, the lengths of the sides of the triangle remain invariant.
questions.explanationQuestion: This question tests the understanding of geometric reflections in the Cartesian plane as discussed on page 11.
questions.correctAnswer: The lengths of the sides of the triangle are preserved.

questions.topic: Page 7: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 7-8 Focus)
questions.questionText: Given the points $A(3, 4)$ and $D(7, 1)$, calculate the length of the segment $AD$ using the Baudhayana-Pythagoras Theorem as derived in the text. Show your steps.

subjective_evaluation_points.point: Identifies the change in x-coordinates: $\Delta x = 7 - 3 = 4$.
Identifies the change in y-coordinates: $\Delta y = 1 - 4 = -3$.

questions.explanationAnswer: The distance is calculated by finding the horizontal and vertical components of the line segment and applying the Pythagorean theorem, resulting in 5 units.
questions.explanationQuestion: This question requires application of the distance formula derivation shown on page 9.

questions.topic: Page 7: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 7-8 Focus)
questions.questionText: In the room layout activity (Fig 1.1), if the scale is $1$ cm : $1$ foot, and a wall segment measures $5$ cm on the map, the actual length of the wall in the room is $5$ feet.
questions.explanationAnswer: The scale $1$ cm : $1$ foot implies a direct mapping where every unit of distance on the diagram corresponds to the same unit in feet in reality.
questions.explanationQuestion: This tests the practical application of scale interpretation mentioned in the chapter.

questions.topic: Page 7: 1.3 THE 2-D CARTESIAN COORDINATE SYSTEM (Pages 7-8 Focus)
questions.questionText: If Reiaan places his study table such that its feet are at $(8, 9)$, $(11, 9)$, and $(11, 7)$, the fourth foot of the rectangular table must be located at coordinate (______, ______).
questions.explanationAnswer: For a rectangle with sides parallel to the axes, the fourth vertex $(x, y)$ must share an x-coordinate with one adjacent vertex and a y-coordinate with the other. Here, $(8, 7)$ completes the rectangle defined by the other three points.
questions.explanationQuestion: This tests the practical geometric reasoning required to place objects on a coordinate grid.
